pack.name: EmpireDivers Forge
pack.notes: EmpireDivers r51 (v2.1.3): Fixed Extraction Lambda duplicate-mkeys crash (ef3a4136b21592cb) + all 6 >64-bone GPU palette units + stock-rebased EXO-49/51/55 AT-ST walkers; glowing Rogue One K-2SO photoreceptor optics; restored FS-23/SA-32/TR-62 left forearms; cleaned 60 jagged helmet rims & calibrated 66 glossy MRA helmets; converted all 12 legacy LEGO variants (including CM-09 Bikini Stormtrooper) to Compact LEGO; upgraded JFO Stormtrooper helmet radio VO & PTT squelch; and removed stray CIS skybox hulls.
pack.statusNotes: Verified across all 5 tiers (full, lighter, reduced1024, reduced512, potato256) with 0 duplicate keys, 0 missing dependencies, 0 codec mismatches, and 100% unit_safe (<=64 bones, unique mkeys).
